note: Every district code below is real and live-verified (services1.arcgis.com/ioennV6PpG5Xodq0 Zoning/FeatureServer layer 0, filtered to JURISDICTION='FAIRFAX COUNTY', 2026-08-15) -- unlike va-loudoun-county's pilot districts.json, NONE of these carry researched district names, categories, or data-center permitted-use status yet. This intentionally ships as an honest 'geometry proven, classification pending' state rather than guessing at names or eligibility, the same pattern used for va-prince-william-county. The raw GIS service also carries a coarse ZONETYPE grouping field (RESIDENTIAL/COMMERCIAL/INDUSTRIAL/PLANNED UNITS/OTHER/TYSON, each spanning many of these codes) -- it is not a per-code district name or a data-center classification and is deliberately not mapped into district_category here, to avoid a category label that reads as more researched than it is. See jurisdiction.json's known_limitations for what remains.
